items.headline: Tyler Shough and Saints score 34 consecutive points, hold on to beat Giants 34-27 and end skid
items.description: — Tyler Shough threw touchdown passes to Bryce Lance, Alvin Kamara and Chris Olave and ran for a score, Isaiah Stalbird forced a fumble on a kick return and the New Orleans Saints scored 34 consecutive points, holding on to defeat the New York Giants...
